decisions.reason: As a new compliance-related tool close to the core agency offer, with some positive early signal and likely low incremental cost to maintain, it is still a worthwhile option to keep open.

Because the hosting management platform builds directly on the firm’s core capabilities and was prominent on the home page, management would likely continue backing it while uncertainty is still resolving.

A configurable managed hosting plan fits the established business closely and should be relatively inexpensive to continue offering, so the firm would likely retain it rather than abandon it after only one year.
